description: I'm a B.Sc. Data Science student and Team Lead with interests in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, and space technology. I'll lead the ML and data analysis development for our NASA Space Apps project. I'm looking for passionate teammates skilled in Python, web development, GIS, data visualization, UI/UX, and research. Beginners are welcome if they are committed, collaborative, and eager to learn. Let's build something impactful together!
